name: TriZetto (Cognizant)
short_description: TriZetto (Cognizant) provides enterprise healthcare clearinghouse and revenue cycle management for large health systems.
long_description: TriZetto, owned by Cognizant Technology Solutions, is an enterprise healthcare IT company providing clearinghouse services, revenue cycle management, and healthcare data analytics. The platform is designed for large health systems, hospitals, and high-volume billing operations requiring maximum first-pass acceptance rates and extensive payer connectivity. TriZetto processes billions of healthcare transactions annually and offers solutions for claims processing, eligibility verification, and payment management. The company is typically used by enterprise-scale organizations rather than small practices.
one_liner: Enterprise healthcare clearinghouse and RCM from Cognizant.
best_for: Large health systems and hospital groups
Multi-specialty medical groups with high claim volumes
Billing companies handling complex claims at scale
Organizations needing the highest first-pass acceptance rates
